title: Automorphism groups and Homogeneous fibrations on projective varieties with nef anticanonical divisors
summary: We explore the homogeneous structures of Albanese morphisms and maximal rationally chain-connected fibrations of algebraic varieties with nef anticanonical divisors. Furthermore, we show that there exists a natural group homomorphism associated with a maximal rationally chain-connected fibration, which induces the Chevalley decomposition of $\operatorname{Aut}^0$ up to an isogeny. This result is analogous to a similar theorem of Nishi and Matsumura for Albanese morphisms. In addition, we reprove Nishi and Matsumura's theorem using the modern language of algebraic geometry.
